reviews.comment: I cannot stress how rewarding it has been to take classes with Dr. Spalink in the Performance Studies Department. I think she is the perfect professor to teach Capstone, as she really cares about the students and their projects, and is always there to help provide suggestions and workshop ideas with students!

I love Dr. Spalink's classes! Took this seminar in Ecology and Performance, and it's been a blast! You will have to read a lot (links provided for weekly readings). You also have to do a Group Presentation on a week's readings, and you're able to have lots of fun with it! Be sure you write all of the papers, quite a few, but they're not very hard.

Dr. Spalink is amazing! For intro to performance studies she is great! In this class, expect lots of participation in groups for acting as well as papers on topics and analyzing performances! Dr. Spalink is also super kind and will help you out with any questions you have. Take her!!
I LOVED Dr. Spalink! She is so caring and sweet. I am happily taking her again next semester. Its a performance class so as long as you participate and turn in your assignments you will pass.

Dr Spalink is a nice prof, the class was easy enough. A few papers due throughout the semester, other than that just some reading homework. She is big on movement and group activity and discussion. Nice and pretty understanding. Not my favorite prof but I would take her again.

The fact that this class is an upper level course is INSANE. You don't have to show up, lectures have nothing to do with the papers and you never have to open the textbook. This has by far been my easiest class all of college. She is a great woman and loves to teach her students, so go to class, but still - easiest class of college. TAKE HER!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Spalink's class required a lot of work but was not too difficult. It's a writing intensive course so be ready for that. As long as you participate in class (it's probably a small class) and do your best to write coherent and insightful papers, you'll be fine. Start early on your final performance.
